0022600156.text: The LA Clippers (1-4, 0-3 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (3-3, winners of three straight) in the Clippers' sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Clippers 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and the Warriors 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and 10th in the West. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 115-110 win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), while the Warriors are without Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest), with Gui Santos listed as day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision.
